# testing_oas_security_operation (Resource)

OASSecurityOperation Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_oas_security_operation" "my_oassecurityoperation" {
  local_string = "...my_local_string..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `audience` (String, Sensitive) Custom operation OAuth Client Credentials flow description audience.
- `client_id` (String, Sensitive) Custom operation OAuth Client Credentials flow description client identifier.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Custom operation OAuth Client Credentials flow description client secret.
- `custom_operation_key` (String, Sensitive) Custom operation security scheme key.
- `custom_operation_secret` (String, Sensitive) Custom operation security scheme secret.
- `local_string` (String)
- `operation_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Custom operation API Key security scheme description.
- `operation_bearer` (String, Sensitive) Custom operation HTTP Bearer token description.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Custom operation HTTP Basic security scheme description password.
- `token_url` (String, Sensitive) Custom operation OAuth Client Credentials flow description token URL.
- `username` (String, Sensitive) Custom operation HTTP Basic security scheme description username.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_oas_security_operation.my_testing_oas_security_operation
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_oas_security_operation.my_testing_oas_security_operation "..."
```
